content.title: Michigan's Yaxel Lendeborg makes Fab Five promise before championship game
content.text: Even though Michigan's legendary Fab Five never won a national championship, they're still considered one of the greatest and most influential teams in college basketball -- and NCAA sports -- history.Now, 34 years later, Dusty May and the Wolverines have a chance to finish the job and win just the second title in program history.That's why, despite his injuries and facing a tough rival like the UConn Huskies, Michigan star forward Yaxel Lendeborg vowed to win the title to honor the Fab Five:“It's going to take a full 40 minutes of fighting and bringing our best effort,” Lendeborg said after the game (h/t TNT Sports). “We have the squad to do it. We all love each other, and that plays a big part in the games like Monday night. So, we're going to do the best we can, and the Fab Five is here, so we're going to do the best to honor those guys, too.”INDIANAPOLIS, INDIANA - APRIL 04: Yaxel Lendeborg #23 of the Michigan Wolverines reacts after shooting a three pointer against the Arizona Wildcats du...The legendary quintet, consisting of Chris Webber, Jalen Rose, Juwan Howard, Jimmy King, and Ray Jackson, was in attendance to watch Lendeborg and the Wolverines punch their tickets to the title game with a dominant 91-73 outing against the Arizona Wildcats.It was an eventful night for Lendeborg, though. "The Dominican LeBron" picked up two quick fouls and had to sit for most of the first ten minutes of the game. Then, he sustained a knee and ankle sprain and had to leave for the medical tent and the locker room.He still battled through it to get back on the court for the second half, finishing the game with 11 points on 3-of-4 shooting, adding three boards and one assist. However, he had a visible limp and was struggling to move for most of the second half.Now, the Wolverines will face a tougher challenge against Dan Hurley and a Huskies team that will be looking for its third title in the last four years. Will Lendeborg deliver on his promise? We shall see.
